heading: Time for Government That Works.

heading: MEET KIMBERLY
text: Kimberly Overman is a mom, grandmother, small business owner, and former Hillsborough County Commissioner running for Congress in Florida’s 12th District. A champion for working families and a proven leader during times of crisis, Kimberly brings both lived experience and a track record of results. From affordable housing to public health, she has always fought to make government work for the people—not special interests. Now, she’s ready to take that fight to Washington.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: From the cost of living to the classroom, Kimberly Overman is running to make government deliver for working people—fighting for fair wages, quality healthcare, strong schools, and safe communities.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: Kimberly knows what it’s like to juggle bills and worry about rent. In Congress, she’ll fight for real solutions to rising costs, including affordable housing, infrastructure investment, and fair wages.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: Healthcare isn’t a luxury—it’s a right. Kimberly will work to expand access to care, lower prescription costs, and defend reproductive rights and mental health services.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: Florida’s 12th is home to thousands of veterans. Kimberly will ensure they receive the benefits, healthcare, and respect they’ve earned.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: Every child deserves a strong start. Kimberly will fight for fully funded public schools, better teacher pay, and pathways to college, trade careers, and lifelong learning.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: Kimberly is committed to protecting voting rights, restoring trust in government, and making sure everyday people—not lobbyists—have a seat at the table.

heading: THE ISSUES
text: Safe communities start with smart investments. Kimberly supports balanced public safety policies that combine law enforcement with prevention, youth programs, and mental health care.

heading: What Kimberly Stands For
text: Kimberly Overman is running for Congress to deliver what Florida’s 12th District deserves but isn’t getting: leadership that listens, acts, and puts people first.

heading: What Kimberly Stands For
text: Her approach is grounded in decades of public service, small business experience, and the realities of working-class life—from raising a family to navigating housing insecurity. She knows what’s at stake because she’s lived it.

heading: What Kimberly Stands For
text: Kimberly’s priorities reflect what voters across the district are demanding: affordable housing, accessible healthcare, economic stability, reproductive freedom, and a government that works for everyone—not just the wealthy or well-connected.

heading: Affordable Housing & Cost of Living
text: As someone who grew up in a working-class household and has helped others manage through financial hardship, Kimberly understands the urgent need for economic stability. In Congress, she’ll fight for increased investment in affordable housing, expanded transportation options, and stronger support for working families and small businesses. She believes housing, transit, and child care are essential infrastructure—and should be treated as such.

heading: Healthcare Access
text: Kimberly has seen firsthand how medical bills can destabilize families. She will work to lower prescription drug costs, expand coverage—especially mental health care—and protect access to reproductive services. No one should have to choose between seeing a doctor and paying their rent.

heading: Public Safety & Crime Prevention
text: Kimberly supports public safety policies that work: strong law enforcement paired with investments in mental health services, youth engagement, and community-led crime prevention. She knows safety comes from both accountability and opportunity.

heading: Education & Workforce Development
text: Kimberly believes public education is the foundation of opportunity. She will advocate for stronger investments in schools, competitive teacher pay, and expanded access to early childhood education, vocational training, and higher education that prepares students for good-paying jobs.

heading: Veterans & Military Families
text: With over 45,000 veterans and active-duty personnel in the district, Kimberly knows our service members deserve more than just symbolic support. She’ll fight to improve access to VA care, mental health services, job training, and transitional support for returning veterans.

heading: Reproductive Rights & Personal Freedom
text: Kimberly trusts people to make their own healthcare decisions. She will fight to restore and protect the right to abortion and access to reproductive care—because these decisions belong to individuals, not politicians

heading: Climate Resilience & Environmental Protection
text: For Florida families, climate change isn’t abstract – it shows up in flooding, rising insurance costs, water quality, and extreme heat. Kimberly understands that climate resilience is affordability: when communities skip investment in drainage, flood mitigation, and clean water infrastructure, families pay through higher premiums and repair bills. In Congress, she’ll fight for resilient infrastructure, protection of the Florida Wildlife Corridor, and environmental justice for the communities hit hardest – because safeguarding our air, water, and coastline lowers long-term costs for working families.

heading: Endorsed by the Florida LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus
text: Kimberly Overman has earned the endorsement of the Florida LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus – a recognition given to candidates who champion equality and are committed to governing with the full dignity and rights of LGBTQ+ Floridians in mind.

heading: Endorsed by the Florida LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus
text: Standing up for every member of our community is a core value of Kimberly’s campaign. She believes in building a Florida where LGBTQ+ residents can live, work, and raise families free from discrimination, and where their rights are protected rather than treated as a political bargaining chip. That means listening to the families, young people, and neighbors across Florida’s 12th Congressional District who are fighting for equal protection under the law, and carrying their voices to Washington.

heading: Endorsed by the Florida LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus
text: The Caucus’s endorsement is a signal to voters, volunteers, and supporters that Kimberly stands with the LGBTQ+ community in the fight for equality and safety. It’s a responsibility she takes seriously, and a commitment she will carry into office .
